title: Highly knowledgeable guide
text: Seeing the Alcazar was a wonderful experience. The visible architecture is amazing. Our guide, Rosa, was extremely knowledgeable, giving us a terrific education of the Seville history, the palace history, meaning associated with the architecture, and special stories. She spoke excellent English.
author: DennisB802

title: A marvel. It is very worthwhile, probably one of the excursions that is most worthwhile in Seville. A rip-off.
text: Everything perfect. The guide Carlos is a real phenomenon. The explanations he gives you during the visit are a 10.
author: Juan_A

title: Fun tour
text: Jose Luis was a great tour guide, very knowledgeable and entertaining of the area. Keep people engaged and on time to make it through the whole area
author: Jessica_G

title: Very beautiful visit
text: Very good visit, the ticket includes skip-the-line access and the guide.. very useful for calmly discovering the whole history of this much-remodeled palace. Beautiful architectural and historical discovery by a very pleasant and very knowledgeable guide.
author: Louis_P

title: Tour of Alcazar palace
text: Really enjoyed the tour, very knowledgeable guide. Tour lasted around 75 minutes. You are free to stay in the gardens afterwards
author: Helen_R

title: Great guide and superb tour
text: Slightly delayed start to the tour, but all went smoothly after that. Our guide, Ivan, was very organised and led the group brilliantly. He knew so much about the Alcazar and the history in great detail. He was also humorous and had so many anecdotes. This was so educational and in a fun way. Highly recommended!
author: Jonathan_B

title: Merce tour guide!
text: Merce was a fantastic guide. The pickup was a bit confusing as we went to the entrance of the alcazar rather than the tour office but once we figured it out it was easy as can be! Very informative and easy to understand
author: W9170LNamandap

title: Alcazar of Seville
text: Alcazar absolutely to be visited and given the historical and architectural complexity of the various parts having a quality guide is highly recommended. Rebeca was very good, she knows the history and architecture and is very passionate and engaging. Beautiful tour, I wish it had lasted longer.
author: filippobZ5334WX

title: 100% recommend
text: Its a wonderful and short intro. My 6 year old did great and loved it. Minimal walking. Our guide, Angeles, was phenomenal and so knowledgeable. It is hard to find activities that will not bore a child and this was the perfect time for the fiancé and I to learn something that doesn't have to do with Bluey.
author: Zandra_N
